correctness.summary: Expanding the Euclidean nonexpansiveness condition for I-omega B and applying an invertible congruence gives the exact criterion omega I <= B^{-1}+B^{-T}; for B=D^{-1}A this is omega <= lambda_min(A^{-1}D+DA^{-1}). In 2x2, direct inversion gives (2ad-|c|(a+d))/(ad-c^2). Fixing eigenvalues to 1 and kappa reduces the robust optimization to a one-variable convex quadratic over the exact rotation range for |c|, yielding the piecewise envelope and the sharp crossings 3+2sqrt(2) and 7+4sqrt(3). Deterministic numerical checks reproduce all identities, extrema, and threshold behavior.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Classical weighted-Jacobi references, condition-number analyses for Jacobi, and related Euclidean-norm optimization of SOR/MSOR operators were checked. Searches for exact and synonymous formulations did not locate the fixed-matrix ceiling lambda_min(A^{-1}D+DA^{-1}), the two-dimensional robust envelope, or the radical Euclidean-contractivity thresholds in the weighted-Jacobi setting. Several broad historical monographs were not inspected end to end at theorem level, so residual prior-coverage risk remains.

value.summary: The result gives a direct certificate for Euclidean stepwise safety and sharply separates it from spectral convergence. In dimension two it quantifies exactly how damping enlarges the universally safe condition-number regime and identifies a finite threshold beyond which no positive damping can eliminate Euclidean transient amplification for all systems.

limitations: Exact arithmetic, real SPD matrices, and simultaneous weighted Jacobi only.
The condition-number-only sharp envelope is proved only in dimension two.
The metric is Euclidean one-step error norm; other norms and residual measures are not covered.
No floating-point, smoothing-factor, multigrid, asymptotic-optimality, or performance claim is made.
Complete theorem-level text of several broad historical monographs was not inspected end to end, leaving residual originality risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.
